sets.relationshipLabel: two ends of one axis of movement
sets.explanation: Ascent and descent, outbound and inbound each name the opposite poles of a single line of travel.

sets.relationshipLabel: raw material becomes finished part through manufacture
sets.explanation: Steel is worked into a frame and rubber into a tire — each pair is a material transformed by making, not just a thing that has a part.

sets.relationshipLabel: two moments facing each other across one journey
sets.explanation: Departure faces arrival and prologue faces final stage — the first and last markers of a single journey, whether a trip or a stage race.

sets.relationshipLabel: a kind of thing and one of them by name
sets.explanation: A pass and a trail are categories; the Stelvio and the Camino de Santiago are specific, named instances of each.
